### Highlights

- DisplayMux now allows only one application instance to run at a time, preventing duplicate windows and background processes after repeated launches.
- When DisplayMux is already running, launching it again exits the new process and shows, restores, and focuses the existing main window.

### Compatibility

- The single-instance restriction supports both Windows and macOS without changing existing tray, autostart, or display-switching settings.

### Known limitations

- The macOS DMG is ad-hoc signed but not notarized with an Apple Developer ID, so Gatekeeper may require manual approval.
- Some MST, DisplayLink, and Silicon Motion docks do not forward DDC/CI. Software cannot restore control signals that the hardware does not expose.
